observations.observation: Heading outline: the original has no h1 or h2. Its outline starts at h4 for the promo cards and then goes to h3 for state names, with 17 h5s. The AI-built page has one h1 ('New heights, together.'), five h2s, eight h3s, fifteen h4s for gym names and three h5s for footer labels.

tags.value: changed: flat irregular outline becomes structured h1 h2 h3 h4

observations.observation: Semantic landmarks: the original has 1 header, 2 navs, 5 sections and 15 articles (one per location). It has no main and no aria attributes, and lang is empty. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 4 sections and 0 articles. Its cards are divs, it has 2 aria attributes and lang='en'.

tags.value: changed: articles and many headers become sections and footer
changed: empty lang becomes lang en

observations.observation: Both pages put a raster PNG brand logo at the left of a white header. The original's logo is 300x64; the AI-built page's is 205x44.

tags.value: kept: raster logo at left of white header

observations.observation: The original repeats a very large logo (817x176) mid-page above the mission statement. The AI-built page uses the logo only in the header.

tags.value: dropped: large repeated mid-page logo above mission

observations.observation: Header right side: the original has underlined utility links (Gift Cards, Contact Us), a 'Find a Location' state select and a search input. The AI-built header holds the horizontal nav of 7 links on the right instead.

tags.value: changed: header utility links, location select and search
changed: nav moves into right side of header

observations.observation: Main nav placement: the original puts 7 white links, divided by pipes, in a separate full-width solid blue bar (rgb(1,96,153)) below the header. The AI-built page puts 7 plain navy links inline in the white header bar.

tags.value: changed: separate solid blue bar becomes inline navy links in white header

observations.observation: Both main navs are flat lists of seven items with no dropdowns, and both include a Covid-19 item. The original's items are Options to Climb, Locations, Covid-19 Updates, About, Franchising, Contact and Careers. The AI-built page's are Options to Climb, Locations, Covid-19, About, Franchising, Contact and Gift Cards.

tags.value: kept: flat seven item list without dropdowns

observations.observation: Hero: the original has a full-photo carousel (1310x442) of a climbing wall, with no headline or CTA, two carousel dots and a hidden second slide. The AI-built hero is a navy band split into two columns: a white 51.2px h1, a paragraph and two buttons on the left, and a rounded, shadowed photo on the right.

tags.value: changed: full-bleed photo carousel becomes two-column navy hero with rounded photo

observations.observation: The AI-built hero has a paired CTA: an orange filled 'Find a gym' pill and an outlined white 'Buy a gift card' pill. The original hero has no CTA.

tags.value: added: orange filled and outline hero pill buttons

observations.observation: Both pages have a four-column 'options' row with Gift Cards, Waivers, Covid visiting and Franchising. The original shows each as a 305x178 photo, a bold blue h4, a gray rule and a paragraph, with no card border. The AI-built page uses bordered white cards (250x344) with an h3, a paragraph and an underlined text link, and no photos.

tags.value: changed: photo columns become bordered text cards with link

observations.observation: Bottom edges in the four-up options row: in the original, uneven text lengths leave the column bottoms misaligned. In the AI-built page the cards are equal height, but links sit at different y values, and the 'Visiting during Covid-19' h3 wraps at the hyphen.

tags.value: changed: misaligned columns become equal height cards with uneven links

observations.observation: Font: the original uses the Roboto web font (425 elements), plus FontAwesome for icons (10 elements). The AI-built page uses a single system-ui stack (185 elements) with no web font or icon font.

tags.value: changed: roboto and icon font become system-ui stack
changed: icon fonts for social and ui glyphs

observations.observation: Body text: the original sets mid-gray rgb(99,99,99) at 16px/24px. The AI-built page sets near-black rgb(22,32,46) at 17px/27.2px, with a second, lighter gray rgb(86,98,117) for card and subtitle copy.

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 16px 1.5 becomes 17px 1.6
changed: mid-grey body text becomes near-black with grey meta

observations.observation: Heading color: the original uses brand blue rgb(1,96,153) for card headings and dark navy rgb(28,53,83) for state headings. The AI-built page uses navy rgb(29,53,87) for headings at 35.2px/700 for h2s.

tags.value: changed: blue headings become navy bold h2s

observations.observation: Palette: the original uses white, brand blue rgb(1,96,153) (19 backgrounds), dark gray rgb(51,51,51), red accent rgb(237,31,36) and darker navy rgb(1,64,102). The AI-built page uses white, navy rgb(29,53,87), orange rgb(228,87,46), peach rgb(253,232,225) and pale blue-gray rgb(242,245,249).

tags.value: changed: blue and red becomes navy with orange accent
changed: red accent becomes burnt orange

observations.observation: Section backgrounds: the original keeps the content on white, with blue only in the nav and footer bands. The AI-built page alternates white, pale gray and navy section bands with about 64px top padding.

tags.value: changed: white page becomes alternating white grey and navy bands

observations.observation: The original has a two-column intro block: a 'Links' sidebar of blue bold links on the left, and the large logo with a bold mission paragraph on the right. The AI-built page has no sidebar link list.

tags.value: dropped: blue bold links sidebar beside mission

observations.observation: Mission/About copy: the original sets the mission statement as a bold gray paragraph under the large logo. The AI-built page puts About Us and Franchising side by side in two 510px columns with regular-weight dark text; the column tops are offset (y=2688 vs 2712), and Franchising has an orange 'Get in touch' pill.

tags.value: changed: mission paragraph becomes two-column about and franchising

observations.observation: In the AI-built page, each h2 is followed by a one-line muted gray subtitle paragraph (680px wide). The original has no h2s and no comparable subtitle pattern.

tags.value: added: muted subtitle paragraph under each h2

observations.observation: Both pages group locations by state under h3 headings in the order California, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, with cards in a three-column grid. The original separates groups with thin pale-blue rules; the AI-built page gives each h3 a short orange underline.

tags.value: changed: pale rules become short orange heading underline

observations.observation: Location card imagery: the original cards each have a 353x253 photo or rendering with a thin dark border. The AI-built location cards have no images, only a title and text.

tags.value: changed: location card photos

observations.observation: On both pages, location descriptions vary in length: Brick and Montclair have none, while Melville has about 7 lines. Card heights or text blocks are therefore uneven. In the AI-built page, cards in a row stretch to equal height.

tags.value: kept: uneven description lengths with equalized card heights

observations.observation: Location name style: the original shows a gray 'City, ST' text name. The AI-built page shows an underlined navy h4 link, while the titles of unopened gyms are plain text.

tags.value: changed: grey city name becomes underlined navy h4 link

observations.observation: Coming-soon marker: the original overlays a red rgb(237,31,36) 'Coming Soon!' ribbon with a notched end on the top-left of the photo (Marin, Nassau, Lehigh Valley, Philadelphia). The AI-built page uses a peach pill badge with dark-orange, uppercase, letter-spaced 'COMING SOON' text.

tags.value: changed: red ribbon becomes peach pill coming soon badge

observations.observation: Image count and density: the original is image-heavy, with 26 img elements and many location photos. The AI-built page has only 2 images (the logo and the hero photo) and is text-led.

tags.value: changed: many photos become two images and text-led

observations.observation: Alt text: the original's images have empty alt text, with one alt attribute missing. The AI-built page's images all have alt text (alt_missing 0), and the hero alt is descriptive.

tags.value: changed: empty alts become descriptive alts

observations.observation: Both pages show raster images larger than their natural size. In the original, 350px images render at 353px through a resizer. In the AI-built page, the 326x233 hero image renders at 486x233.

tags.value: kept: raster images upscaled beyond natural size

observations.observation: Border radius: the original is almost entirely square (431 at 0, 2 at 1-7px, 2 pills, none at 8-15px). The AI-built page uses 22 elements at 8-15px (cards, select, input, image) and 7 pills, with 156 square.

tags.value: changed: square corners become small rounding and pills

observations.observation: Primary button: the original's 'Go To My Gym' is a blue rgb(1,96,153) rectangle with 0px radius and 3px 15px 4px padding. The AI-built page's 'Find a gym' is an orange rgb(228,87,46) pill with 999px radius and 12px 22px padding.

tags.value: changed: blue rectangle becomes orange pill button

observations.observation: Effects: neither page uses gradients, backdrop blur, animations or transforms. The original has 4 box shadows (including a subtle nav shadow) and 10 transitions. The AI-built page has 1 box shadow (on the hero image) and 0 transitions.

tags.value: changed: many transitions become fewer transitions

observations.observation: In the AI-built page, cards are separated from the background by a thin light-gray border on a white fill with no shadow. The original's location cards have no border; instead, the border sits on their photos.

tags.value: added: thin grey border on white cards

observations.observation: Footer structure: the original has two stacked blue bands. The upper band has a newsletter signup and five white social icons; the lower, darker navy band has copyright and policy links. The AI-built footer is one navy block with three columns (Explore, Follow, Legal) under bold white h5 labels, with a divider and copyright line below.

tags.value: changed: two blue bands become navy three-column footer

observations.observation: Newsletter form: the original's sits in the blue footer band, with an envelope icon, a centered-placeholder 'e-mail' input and a check-circle icon submit. The AI-built page's is a single-row form in a pale gray section: a 945px email input and an orange pill 'Sign up' button.

tags.value: changed: footer icon form becomes single email row with pill button

observations.observation: Both footers show a © 2021 Gravity Vault copyright.

tags.value: kept: copyright line

observations.observation: Layout technique: the original uses no display:grid or display:flex, relies on float/table-style layout and has 151 divs. The AI-built page uses 8 grid and 4 flex containers with 42 divs.

tags.value: changed: floats and fixed widths become flex plus grid
changed: heavy div markup becomes minimal markup

observations.observation: Content width: the original's location area spans about 1100px (x170-1270), but the hero and promo row run wider at 1310px (x65-1375). The AI-built page aligns everything to one centered column about 1060px wide (x190-1250).

tags.value: changed: mixed widths become centered 1060px column

observations.observation: Styling code: the original has 377 class uses across 140 unique classes, 31 inline style attributes, 3 stylesheets, 2 style blocks and 17 scripts. The AI-built page has 51 class uses across 18 unique classes, 2 inline styles, no external stylesheet, 1 style block and 1 script. Neither uses a utility-class pattern.

tags.value: changed: many class names become few custom classes

observations.observation: Copy tone: the original is exclamatory and community-oriented, with 19 exclamation marks and 1 emoji. The AI-built page is plain and informational, with 0 exclamation marks and 0 emoji. Both have about 560-570 words.

tags.value: changed: exclamatory ctas become plain sentences

observations.observation: Both pages keep legacy Covid-19 content: a nav item ('Covid-19 Updates' / 'Covid-19') and an options card ('Visiting Us During This Time' / 'Visiting during Covid-19').

tags.value: kept: covid nav item and visiting card

observations.observation: Page length: the original is 4323px tall, with the long scroll mostly location cards. The AI-built page is 3674px tall, and the Locations section (about 1610px) takes about 44% of it.

tags.value: changed: taller page becomes shorter page

observations.observation: Link styling: the original varies by region. Sidebar links are blue, bold and not underlined; header utility links are underlined in gray; nav links are plain white. The AI-built page underlines links consistently (navy on light, white in the footer) and leaves only the header nav plain.

tags.value: changed: underlined body and footer text links

observations.observation: Anchor and button counts: the original has 84 anchors and 2 buttons. The AI-built page has 42 anchors and 1 button element, and its CTAs mix orange pills with underlined text links.

tags.value: changed: fewer anchors with orange pills and text links
changed: fewer anchors and more words

observations.observation: State selector: the original has a 'Find a Location' select with a visible small gray label and a blue chevron in the header, alongside a search input. The AI-built page has a 220x46 rounded state-filter select inside the Locations section, with a visually hidden label and no search input.

tags.value: changed: header location select and search become rounded state filter in locations

observations.observation: Page title and meta: the original's title is 'The Gravity Vault | Indoor Rock Climbing Gyms | NJ, NY & PA', and its meta tags include keywords, author and google-site-verification. The AI-built page's title is 'The Gravity Vault | Indoor Rock Gyms', and its meta tags are only charset, viewport and description. Neither has JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: rich social and json-ld meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: Both pages use generous vertical spacing. The original has about 50px gaps between rows and hairline rules between region groups. The AI-built page has about 64px of section padding and 16-20px card gaps.

tags.value: changed: inconsistent indents become regular gutters and padding

observations.observation: Social links: the original shows five white FontAwesome social icons in the footer. The AI-built page has a text-link 'Follow' footer column with no icons.

tags.value: changed: icon glyphs become plain text links

observations.observation: The AI-built footer includes a credit link to the web agency ('Lform Design'). The original's judge did not mention a comparable credit.

tags.value: added: web agency credit link
